module_summary: Wishbone safety bridge: skid-buffers master requests to an untrusted slave, counts outstanding returns and stall/ack timeouts, flags protocol faults and resets the slave.

anchors.name: o_fault
anchors.why: Sticky fault set on faulty return or timeout; blocks bus and triggers slave reset.

anchors.name: expected_returns
anchors.why: Outstanding request count; increments on issue, decrements on ack, checks returns.

anchors.name: none_expected
anchors.why: No outstanding requests; gates wait timer and unexpected-ack reset.

anchors.name: faulty_return
anchors.why: Detects unexpected or simultaneous ack/err; sets fault and error response.

anchors.name: timeout
anchors.why: Stall or ack-wait timeout; raises fault, slave reset and upstream error.

anchors.name: stall_timer
anchors.why: Counts consecutive downstream stall cycles toward timeout.

anchors.name: wait_timer
anchors.why: Counts cycles waiting for ack toward timeout.

anchors.name: o_reset
anchors.why: Downstream slave reset on fault, timeout or unexpected ack; blocks bus outputs.

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: Upstream request strobe into skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: Upstream stall from skid buffer not ready.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Upstream write data packed into skid buffer.

anchors.name: i_wb_addr
anchors.why: Upstream address packed into skid buffer.

anchors.name: i_wb_we
anchors.why: Upstream write/read command packed into skid buffer.

anchors.name: i_wb_sel
anchors.why: Upstream byte selects packed into skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: Upstream ack forwarded only for valid, non-faulty slave acks.

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: Upstream error on timeout, faulty return, slave err or while faulted.

anchors.name: o_wb_idata
anchors.why: Registered read data returned upstream.

anchors.name: skd_stb
anchors.why: Buffered request valid from skid buffer loading o_wb_stb.

anchors.name: skd_stall
anchors.why: Back-pressure into skid buffer from slave stall or reset.

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Downstream request strobe, killed on error, reset or fault.

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Downstream bus cycle, dropped on error, reset or fault.

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Registered downstream address from skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Registered downstream write data from skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_we
anchors.why: Registered downstream write enable from skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Registered downstream byte selects.

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Slave ack checked for faults and forwarded upstream.

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Slave stall holding requests and driving stall timer.

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Slave error ending the cycle and returning upstream error.

anchors.name: i_wb_idata
anchors.why: Slave read data registered to upstream.

groups.name: Upstream skid buffer
groups.description: Skid buffer capturing upstream request fields and applying downstream back-pressure.

groups.name: Downstream bus driver
groups.description: Registers request to untrusted slave; cyc/stb killed on error, reset or fault.

groups.name: Response return
groups.description: Filters slave ack/err/data into protocol-safe upstream ack/err responses.

groups.name: Return counter
groups.description: Tracks outstanding requests to validate slave returns.

groups.name: Timeout checker
groups.description: Stall and ack-wait timers generating timeout.

groups.name: Fault and reset control
groups.description: Detects faulty returns/timeouts, latches fault and resets the slave.
